snippet.title: Three Misses Confectionery - Visual Novel Trailer
snippet.description:
On a rainy afternoon, a young man takes shelter in a cute and quiet confectionery. Three sweet chefs welcome him enthusiastically and offer irresistible cakes.
The place is so cozy, the girls are so kind, and the desserts are so inviting… It almost feels like the perfect place to spend the rest of your life, doesn’t it?
